actions.ottley_waiting_intro: Sergeant Ottley waits at your elbow, notebook open, water still dripping from his cap.
actions.ottley_looks_up: Ottley looks up from his notebook.
actions.nothing_to_show: You have nothing to show yet.
actions.defensive_text: {name} stiffens and refuses to say anything further.
actions.early_accuse_refusal: "I see. Then I have nothing more to say to you, Inspector. You may address yourself to my lawyer."
actions.grate_roars: Somewhere below stairs a grate roars up, as if a bundle of papers had just been thrown on it.
actions.ilsa_silent_text: Ilsa keeps her back to you and her hands on the bench. She will not be led.

safe.title: Enter the four-digit combination
safe.prompt: Behind the north panel, an iron door. A brass dial with four wheels.
safe.wrong_msg: The wheels turn and stop. Nothing.

deductions.warn_hypothesis: Build a hypothesis from what you have found. The board never tells you whether you are right.
deductions.btn_close_accident: Close the case as an accident
deductions.confirm_close_accident: Report to the Chief Constable that Master Vennard died of apoplexy, and close the case?

inventory_tabs.chain_sum: Heavy gold. One small key, and a bare loop where a larger one hung.
inventory_tabs.chain_desc: A heavy gold watch-chain from the Master's waistcoat. The ring holds one small key, which opens the lower desk drawer, and a bare loop where the larger study key once hung.

evidence.empty: You have found nothing yet. Look around.

timeline.empty: Nothing is established yet. Timelines are built from testimony, registers and documents.

save.info_none: No saved game yet. The game also autosaves.
save.typewriter_label: Typewriter effect (you can always skip by tapping the text)
save.confirm_new: Start again? Unsaved progress will be lost.

accusation.warn: Name one person, then choose the clues that prove it. The ending will judge both.
accusation.evidence_lbl: What is your evidence? (up to five)
accusation.no_evidence: You have no evidence at all.
accusation.toast_five_max: Five pieces of evidence at most.
accusation.err_no_evidence: You cannot accuse anyone without evidence.

endings.hidden_prompt: You hold the whole truth in your notebook. What will you do with it?
endings.opt_back_stair: Take Pell down the back stair.
endings.opt_cinder_row: Lay the whole truth of Cinder Row before the Guild.

toasts.three_ev_max: Three pieces of evidence per hypothesis.
toasts.add_something: Add a motive, an opportunity or some evidence.
